name: Walt Minnick
summary:
Walter Clifford Minnick (born September 20, 1942) is an American businessman, politician, and lobbyist who served as the U.S. representative for Idaho's 1st congressional district from 2009 until 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
The district is in the western part of the state, and includes roughly one-fourth of Boise and most of its suburbs, as well as Meridian and Nampa.
